essentialEvidence: Leiden’s official design records place the 30 EC elective space in semester five and describe a broader final assessment. The revised third-year course and credit table, eligible restricted choices, and final assessment options, credits, entry and assessment rules are still unverified for September 2025 and later entrants.
officialAlternative: Compared Leiden’s 2026–2027 Dutch regulations and their Study Guide delegation against Faculty Council minutes and the official Kernvisie design annex. The council minutes describe the chosen sequence and concentration of procedure in year three. The design sketches moot court, clinic and research as alternatives, with detailed design delegated for later work. The older 5 EC thesis and its 120 EC entry rule belong to the outgoing curriculum, so neither can be imported. The annex is design evidence and supplies no adopted course or assessment table for the revised cohort.

sources.finding: 150 EC required and restricted plus 30 EC open, previously 15 through the 2024–2025 cohort. Exam board approval rules and exceptions for recognised minors. Final-work scope, credits and standards delegated to Study Guide.

Council informed of the settled sequence, with 30 EC minor space in semester five, a third-year procedure grouping and broadened final assessment. No detailed year-three table or assessment regulations.

Design distinguishes three prospective culminating formats: moot court, clinic and research, with detailed form, coordination and outcomes assigned to Team 7. Draft detail cannot stand in for adopted entry or assessment rules.
Outgoing 5 EC thesis is an independent legal study and requires propedeuse and 60 additional credits. It applies to a third year delivered before the first revised cohort reaches that year.

sources.locator: Revised years 1–2, outgoing year 3 cohort notice; prior exact annual product independently re-read
sources.finding: 60 EC in year one; 55 EC plus a 5 EC choice in year two. Year three listed for 2024 or earlier entrants; revised year three due in 2027/2028 edition.
Board discussion flags changed and discontinued courses and implementation questions for 2027/2028, without specifying the detailed revised year-three curriculum.
